Name: (CP) Creature pets
Author: RitzyGen
Description:
Hey y'all, it's me again.

Basically what this mod is, well, a slightly different version of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12112]tbh creature pet[/url] mod, by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/matchablaze]matchablaze[/url] . I did message matchablaze, and I have received permission to make my version public. if matchablaze changes their mind, I will either hide, or remove this mod.

the Tbh creature sprites and icon are not mine, I only made minor tweaks to them. the sound files are also not mine. The Btw creature sprites and icon are mostly my doing, however, as they are heavily based off of the Tbh creature's sprites, I won't claim 100% ownership over them.

The code, however, is my work. I will claim ownership over that. that's all.

[size=4]⭐If possible, please show [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/matchablaze]matchablaze[/url]﻿ some love, by downloading or endorsing their mod, or maybe giving them Kudos!⭐[/size]

[size=3]The Tbh creature design belongs to @acmeiku on twitter.
I couldn't figure out who the ADHD/BTW creature belongs to, so if someone could show me their username, or perhaps what platform it was originally posted on, I would be very happy to credit them![/size][size=2]
[/size][size=4]
REQUIREMENTS: 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/size][size=3]

What's different about my version, is it includes a Btw creature pet as well as the Tbh creature, and it doesn't override any pets, It just adds them in as a new cat breed.[/size]
it may have a few issues as I wasn't able to test it as much as I'd've liked, so bug reports are appreciated, please just include a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url] , and report bugs in the BUGS section, not the comments section, if possible.

[size=4]!!!Do NOT use this mod to train AI, or for any AI related purposes!!!

[/size][size=3]
Current language(s): English[/size]

Manifest.Name: (CP) Creature pets
Manifest.Description: Adds the TBH and BTW creature(s) as new cat breeds (rather than replacing pets) with Content Patcher. Original mod made by matchablaze.
